name: Nhat Tru Pagoda
summary: Walk 300 m north of the Le temple to the pagoda that keeps the pillar dated 995. The hall is a chữ Đinh plan, five front bays and three rear bays, in thôn Yên Thành, xã Trường Yên. The national ranking is 1998. A separate gate fee was not printed.
dotReason: The pillar beside the temples, a short extra walk
timeNeeded: A short walk from the Le temple
getThere: About 300 m north of the Le temple, thôn Yên Thành, xã Trường Yên.
heroCaption: The gate of Nhat Tru Pagoda

notice.title: The temple ticket does not name this pagoda
notice.body: The board's Hoa Lu line is 20,000 đồng for an adult at the Dinh and Le temples. That line does not say it includes chùa Nhất Trụ, about 300 m north of the Le temple.

body: The tourism page places the pagoda in xã Trường Yên, about 300 m north of the temple of Lê Đại Hành, in the old capital. The pillar in the court is dated 995, under Lê Đại Hành, carved with a sutra and verses. The three characters on the gate are Nhất Trụ tự, which is why the folk name is chùa Một Cột. The hall is a chữ Đinh plan: five bays in front, three bays in the upper hall, tiled in northern tiles. The upper hall's carpentry is described as Lê, and the front hall's woodwork as Nguyễn. The Ministry of Culture and Information ranked the pagoda a national historic and cultural relic in 1998.

A second tourism page says Decision 2382/QĐ-TTg of 25 December 2015 named the stone scripture pillar a national treasure. It describes six fitted parts: a square base, a round plinth, an eight-sided shaft, an eight-sided capital, and a gourd finial, standing west of the hall. The English page adds that the court is over 3,000 square metres, and that a peace ceremony falls on the 15th of the first lunar month. Walk the gate, the court, and the pillar. A separate fee and a daily hour were not printed.

gettingThere: Walk from the Le temple. The tourism page prints about 300 m north, in thôn Yên Thành, xã Trường Yên. From Ga Ninh Bình, ride to the old capital first. Road minutes were not printed.

legs.heading: From the Le temple
legs.body: About 300 m north, on the tourism page and the English page.

legs.heading: From Ga Ninh Bình
legs.body: Ride to xã Trường Yên, then walk from the temples. Minutes were not printed.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: A separate fee was not on the tourism pages or on the Tràng An ticket board opened 23 October 2026. The Hoa Lu temple line on that board is 20,000 đồng for an adult and does not name this pagoda.
